scope: Proposed Oxford Health pilot; synthetic demonstration and source-only integration foundation

loops.title: Product and function register
loops.acceptance: All 158 source-backed IDs remain consistent; routes, extension requests and local proposal controls work.
loops.limit: Source inspection is not independent execution of upstream Clinical OS tests.

loops.title: Read gateway policy
loops.acceptance: Read allowlist, tenant binding, verified-session inputs, patient access checks and upstream denials pass isolated tests.
loops.limit: Source-only foundation. OH06 and OH07 are not complete identity or tenancy integrations; trusted session and tenant services must be supplied.

loops.title: Patient-to-reviewed-document workflow
loops.acceptance: Three fictional records stay separate; stale reviews cannot sign; amended versions preserve history; form edits require new field review; follow-up tasks retain their signed source.
loops.limit: Browser-local simulation. No server persistence, clinical signature, real files or live workflow writes.

loops.title: Connect an authorised synthetic staging environment
blockers: Approved HTTPS staging origin and deployment owner
Documented session verification and upstream user-token mapping
Tenant and patient permission resolver backed by authoritative records
Server-held sandbox partner key and synthetic test accounts
loops.acceptance: Demonstrate authorised reads and denied cross-tenant/patient reads against the deployed staging service. Real data remains out of scope.
loops.next: Mount the gateway behind the verified session service, then run staging contract and access tests.

loops.title: Connect writes and approved services
blockers: Staging identity and tenant isolation proven in L04
Verified write schemas, concurrency and idempotency contracts
Approved transcription, AI, messaging and vendor service configuration as applicable
loops.acceptance: Prove consent, recording interruption, draft-save-sign-amend, form submission and retry-safe tasks using the real authenticated services. Treat each optional connector as its own gated increment.
loops.next: Inspect each write contract, implement one vertical workflow at a time, test conflicts and denied requests, and keep unavailable services visibly blocked.

loops.title: Assurance and controlled pilot decision
blockers: Named Trust sponsor, clinical safety, information governance and release owners
Confirmed intended purpose, hosting and EPR requirements
Security, manual accessibility, local quality and operational rehearsal evidence
Recorded human decisions on supplier and Trust assurance
loops.acceptance: Named accountable people review evidence for the exact release and approve a bounded pilot, support arrangements and stop criteria.
loops.next: Prepare evidence in parallel; do not equate automated test success with Trust approval.
